name: Rel-Time Protocol
description: Reviews Rel-Time tools that spend hash credits, provision API keys, link Passkeys, or write proof files: reltime_anchor_file, reltime_anchor_hash, reltime_provision_agent_key, reltime_link_passkey, and reltime_stamp_file. reltime_get_sun_stamp, reltime_check_proof, reltime_account_status, and reltime_audit_trail retain Guard's usual handling. Off until enabled.
saferAlternatives: All file hashing in reltime_anchor_file, reltime_stamp_file, reltime_check_proof and reltime_audit_trail runs locally via SHA-256; raw file contents never leave the machine.

Use reltime_account_status, reltime_check_proof, reltime_get_sun_stamp and reltime_audit_trail to inspect credit balance, download 64-ray Sun-Stamps and verify Bitcoin ledger proofs before anchoring new files or provisioning credits.
